info.title: Cisco-IOS-XE-aaa-oper
info.description:
This module contains a collection of YANG definitions
     for AAA operational data.
     Copyright (c) 2017-2019, 2021 by Cisco Systems, Inc.
     All rights reserved.

Cisco IOS-XE operational state data (read-only).
**Category:** Security & AAA
**Paths:** 25

group-name.description:
AAA group name in which the server
         is defined. For public servers the
         group name is \

connection-opens.description: Number of new connection requests sent to the LDAP server.

connection-closes.description: Number of connection close requests sent to the server.

connection-aborts.description:
Number of connections aborted.
         These do not include connections that are close gracefully.

connection-failures.description: Number of connection failures to the LDAP server.

connection-timeouts.description: Number of connection timeouts to the LDAP server.

authen-messages-sent.description: Number of authentication messages sent to the RADIUS server.

author-messages-sent.description: Number of authorization messages sent to the RADIUS server.

acct-messages-sent.description: Number of accounting messages sent to the RADIUS server.

authen-messages-received.description: Number of authentication messages received by the RADIUS server.

author-messages-received.description: Number of authorization messages received by the RADIUS server.

authen-errors-received.description:
Number of authentication error messages received
         from the RADIUS server.

author-errors-received.description:
Number of authorization error messages received
         from the RADIUS server.

acct-errors-received.description:
Number of accounting error messages received
         from the RADIUS server.

stats-time.description:
Time from which the statistics are valid.
         This field will be updated when a RADIUS server is
         configured and also when the RADIUS server statistics
         are cleared.

eap-authen-avg-resp-time.description: Dot1x authentication average response time in milliseconds.

eap-authen-total-response.description: Number of valid Dot1x authentication responses.

eap-authen-success-txns.description: Number of Success Dot1x session transactions.

eap-authen-failed-txns.description: Number of Failed Dot1x session transactions.

eap-authen-total-failover.description: Number of Dot1x session failover requests

mac-authen-avg-resp-time.description: MAB authentication average response time in milliseconds.

mac-authen-total-response.description: Number of valid MAB authentication responses.

mac-authen-success-txns.description: Number of Success MAB session transactions.

mac-authen-failed-txns.description: Number of Failed MAB session transactions.

mac-authen-total-failover.description: Number of MAB session failover requests

mac-author-avg-resp-time.description: MAB authorization average response time in milliseconds.

mac-author-total-response.description: Number of valid MAB authorization responses.

mac-author-total-txns.description: Number of MAB authorization session transactions.

mac-author-success-txns.description: Number of Success MAB authorization session transactions.

mac-author-failed-txns.description: Number of Failed MAB authorization session transactions.

mac-author-total-timeouts.description: Number of MAB authorization session timeouts.

mac-author-total-failover.description: Number of MAB authorization session failover requests

messages-sent.description: Number of messages sent to the LDAP server.

messages-received.description: Number of messages received by the LDAP server.

errors-received.description: Number of error messages received from the LDAP server.

stats-start-time.description:
This attribute contains stats collection start time.
         Stats collection starts when the TACACS server is configured

counters-start-time.description:
This attribute contains LDAP counters collection start time.
         Counters collection starts when a LDAP server is configured.
         Counters collection will be reset when the LDAP server counters
         are cleared.

ip-addr.description: Source IP address that initiated the session

login-time.description: Login-time for this session present in aaa code.

creator.description: Name of the administrator who created the user

view-name.description: Parser View attached to the user

max-login-limit.description: Maximum login limit for the user

user-type.description: The role type of the user

items.description: Names of the groups that the FQDN belongs to.
